status: v1 draft test vectors. The seeds below are published test material: never use them for anything real.

acts.name: valid
acts.description: A current act, admission and grant, for this audience.

acts.name: valid-with-body
acts.description: The body bytes hash to body_sha256.

acts.name: body-mismatch
acts.description: The body is not the one the act committed to.

acts.name: act-expired
acts.description: The act window has closed (expires_at is exclusive).

acts.name: act-not-yet-valid
acts.description: The act claims a time after now.

acts.name: act-last-millisecond
acts.description: One millisecond before expires_at is still inside.

acts.name: wrong-audience
acts.description: The act is addressed to another relying party.

acts.name: scope-not-granted
acts.description: The grant does not include the act's scope.

acts.name: grant-other-audience
acts.description: The grant is for another audience.

acts.name: admission-lapsed-is-dormant
acts.description: Time passing never ends an identity: a lapsed admission is dormant.

acts.name: grant-lapsed-is-dormant
acts.description: A lapsed grant is dormant, not an end.

acts.name: ended-outranks-dormant
acts.description: A revoked admission is ended even after it has also lapsed.

acts.name: admission-revoked
acts.description: The issuer revoked the admission: final.

acts.name: holder-key-revoked
acts.description: The holder's key was revoked (for example, compromised).

acts.name: grant-revoked
acts.description: The grant was revoked.

acts.name: forged-revocation-ignored
acts.description: A revocation not signed by the issuer is ignored.

acts.name: future-revocation-ignored
acts.description: A revocation dated after now does not yet apply.

acts.name: act-unknown-holder-key
acts.description: The act is signed by a key the admission does not list.

acts.name: act-tampered
acts.description: The payload was changed after signing.

acts.name: signature-malleated
acts.description: A signature with S >= L is refused even though the curve equation holds.

acts.name: untrusted-issuer
acts.description: The issuer document is signed by a key that is not pinned.

acts.name: issuer-document-expired
acts.description: An expired issuer document must be refreshed.

acts.name: admission-by-key-outside-validity
acts.description: The admission was signed by issuer key 2 before key 2's not_before.

acts.name: rotated-issuer-key
acts.description: Issuer key 2, inside its validity, signs a later admission.

acts.name: issuer-key-revoked
acts.description: A revoked issuer key invalidates what it signed.

acts.name: act-unknown-member
acts.description: A payload has exactly its listed members.

acts.name: act-window-too-long
acts.description: An act lasts at most 120 seconds.

acts.name: act-float
acts.description: Numbers are integers; 1.5 has no canonical form.

acts.name: unsupported-version
acts.description: eid "2" is not this protocol.

acts.name: wrong-type
acts.description: A grant envelope offered as an act.

acts.name: act-for-another-subject
acts.description: The act names a different subject than the admission.

acts.name: admission-not-disclosed
acts.description: disclosed_ai must be true.

acts.name: holder-key-id-mismatch
acts.description: A key_id must be derived from its public key.

acts.name: act-replayed
acts.description: This relying party already accepted this subject's act-1.

acts.name: other-act-accepted
acts.description: Having accepted a different act id is no reason to refuse this one.

acts.name: payload-too-large
acts.description: A canonical payload is at most 8192 bytes.

permits.name: valid
permits.description: A current permit for exactly these bytes.

permits.name: payload-mismatch
permits.description: The bytes are not the approved bytes.

permits.name: wrong-audience
permits.description: The permit is for another destination.

permits.name: admission-revoked
permits.description: A revoked admission ends its permits too.

permits.name: window-too-long
permits.description: A permit window of 21 seconds is refused.

id_tokens.name: valid
id_tokens.description: A current token for this client and nonce.

id_tokens.name: wrong-nonce
id_tokens.description: The nonce must be the one this sign-in sent.

id_tokens.name: too-long-lived
id_tokens.description: A token lives at most 600 seconds.

id_tokens.name: unknown-kid
id_tokens.description: Signed by a key the JWKS does not hold.

id_tokens.name: tampered
id_tokens.description: The claims were changed after signing.
